General Information
New in the Original Packaging – (Unless Bulk Packed)
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This is the Suzuki Samurai Complete Transmission Needle & Roller Bearing Rebuild Kit.
Includes All Needle & Roller Bearings.
Also Includes the Input Shaft Oil Seal & Extension Case Oil Seal
(Japanese Standards Bearings) Made by FAG / NMK / Suzuki Japan / SKF
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Roller Bearing #3
Qty 1 – Roller Bearing #20
Qty 1 – Roller Bearing #22
Qty 1 – Roller Bearing #27
Qty 1 – Roller Bearing #29
Qty 1 – Roller Bearing #30
Qty 1 – Needle Bearing #2
Qty 1 – Needle Bearing #12
Qty 1 – Needle Bearing #14
Qty 1 – Needle Bearing #16
Qty 1 – Needle Bearing #19
Qty 1 – Needle Bearing #49
Qty 1 – Oil Seal – Input Shaft #6
Qty 1 – Oil Seal – Extension Case
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1986 – 1995 All Models
